src_members.sig: public static string ToGrouped(long value) => value.ToString("N0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
src_members.name: ToGrouped
src_members.comment: 1234567 -> "1,234,567" — culture-invariant so it doesn't silently switch to periods for thousands separators on a machine with a different locale.

src_members.name: ToOrdinal
src_members.comment: 1 -> "1st", 2 -> "2nd", 3 -> "3rd", 4 -> "4th", 11 -> "11th" (the 11-13 exception to the usual rule), -1 -> "-1st" (suffix is chosen from the magnitude — C#'s % returns negative results for negative operands, so checking value % 10 directly would never match cases 1/2/3 for a negative input).
